title: Godot random crash on Linux
body:
### Tested versions

Happens on 4.5.1. Didn't reproduce it on 4.4.

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Graphics (RPL-U) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1365U (12 threads) - 30.98 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot crashed when I tried to:
- Open the Add Child Node menu (with Ctrl+A)
- Open the Add Instantiated Node menu (with Ctrl+Shift+A)
- Create a new scene (with Ctrl+N)

This happens randomly, certainly not all the time (worked for 30+ minutes without a crash). The log during the crash: 
```
===========
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official (f62fdbde15035c5576dad93e586201f4d41ef0cb)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
[1] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x42520) [0x7f7a6ea42520] (??:0)
[2] /opt/Godot/Godot() [0x4d1e18] (??:0)
[3] /opt/Godot/Godot() [0x4332c55] (??:0)
[4] /opt/Godot/Godot() [0x50db243] (??:0)
[5] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x94ac3) [0x7f7a6ea94ac3] (??:0)
[6] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x1268c0) [0x7f7a6eb268c0] (??:0)
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
=====================================================
```
No prior notable error.

### Steps to reproduce

Couldn't really say, since it happens randomly. It happened right after opening the project,  as well as after almost an hour without problem.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-linux-crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24318036/mrp-linux-crash.zip)

Note: I couldn't get the bug on this project after ~5 minutes of trial, but I got it on a bigger, messier project. I can link it, although it's full of unnecessary files even after cleanup (again, because I have no clue of what's provoking the crash).
